entry.title: H1 · Cross-protocol, game-typed certificate format
entry.subtitle: Novelty hypothesis
entry.summary: A machine-checkable certificate that ties every ε to a named game (W1, W1_CV, S1, S2, D1, …), a theorem ID with a source anchor, assumption flags (e.g. P03 Table 6 A–G), and an evidence kind.

fields.label: Statement
fields.text: A machine-checkable certificate that ties every ε to a named game (W1, W1_CV, S1, S2, D1, …), a theorem ID with a source anchor, assumption flags (e.g. P03 Table 6 A–G), and an evidence kind. The certificate refuses out-of-domain parameter tuples (UNCERTIFIED/OUT_OF_MODEL). *New only as engineering/infrastructure.* Not found as an open tool for token protocols. Similar "theorem-preconditions-as-code" ideas exist in QKD tooling.
